name: Swat
description: Pine forests, rivers and meadows from Malam Jabba to Kalam, an easy first trip north for families.
lead: Pine forests, rivers and old Buddhist sites, an easy first trip north for families

image.alt: The green Swat River at Kalam, between pine-covered slopes and a snow-capped peak

overview.headline: Rivers, forests and the old Buddhist valley
paragraphs: Swat runs from the plains at Mingora up to Kalam and beyond, along a river that stays green and cold all summer. Pine forests, orchards and meadows line the way, with the slopes of Malam Jabba above.
It is also one of the oldest Buddhist landscapes in South Asia, with stupas and monasteries around Mingora. Good roads and short drives make it an easy first trip north for families.

seasons.text: Blossom in the lower valley from March. Days 18–25°C in Mingora, cooler in Kalam.
The best time for Kalam and Mahodand Lake. Days 25–32°C lower down, 15–22°C up the valley.
Clear skies and the orchard harvest. Days 15–25°C.
Snow at Malam Jabba from December, for the north’s easiest skiing. Kalam is very cold, and the road above it closes.

places.name: Butkara Stupa
places.text: The ruins of a great Buddhist stupa and its shrines, on the edge of Mingora.

image.alt: The stone base of the great stupa at Butkara, with rows of small votive stupas around it under tall trees

places.name: White Palace
places.text: The marble summer palace of the last Wali of Swat, at Marghazar.

image.alt: The white columned facade of the 1941 White Palace at Marghazar, with rose beds and a lawn in front of wooded hills.

places.name: Malam Jabba
places.text: A chairlift over the pine forest, and ski slopes in winter.

image.alt: Fir trees frame a view across forested ridges and hazy mountains from a green hillside at Malam Jabba.

places.name: Kundol Lake
places.text: A turquoise lake above the Utror valley, a jeep ride and a hike from Kalam.

image.alt: Turquoise Kundol Lake in a high valley of pine-dotted slopes, seen from the hillside above

places.name: Mahodand Lake
places.text: A wide lake in the meadows above Kalam, reached by jeep.

image.alt: Turquoise Mahodand Lake curves through golden meadow grass toward a rocky valley under storm clouds, with pines along the shore.
